caseNameFull: Baker v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Mr. Arthur S. Dayton for petitioners., Acting Solicitor General Judson, Assistant Attorney General Clark, Messrs. Sewall Key and J. Louis Monarch for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
